audio.text: You're coming to the alumni mentoring dinner, aren't you?

options: The dinner menu has three vegetarian options.
Yes, alumni pay a small fee to attend.
I came to campus by train this morning.
I wouldn't miss it; my mentor is flying in for it.

why.en: Indirect "yes": "I wouldn't miss it" means she is definitely going. A describes the menu; C repeats "came" about something else; B says "Yes" but gives unrelated information.
why.tr: Dolaylı "evet": "I wouldn't miss it" kesinlikle gideceği anlamına geliyor. A menüyü anlatıyor; C "came" kelimesini başka bir şey için tekrar ediyor; B "Yes" diyor ama ilgisiz bilgi veriyor.
why.es: Un "sí" indirecto: "I wouldn't miss it" significa que irá sin falta. A describe el menú; C repite "came" sobre otra cosa; B dice "Yes" pero da información que no viene al caso.
